title: In Tanzania, the sea is moving inland – and taking livelihoods with it
content:
Along the coast of Tanzania, in East Africa, the Indian Ocean is pushing saltwater ever farther inland, shrinking coconut harvests, driving fish away and leaving some residents wondering how much longer they can stay. Read Full Story on UN News
